mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eir_order (eir_no, business_type, container_no, container_size, container_type, company_id, status, remark) VALUES (#{eirNo}, #{businessType}, #{containerNo}, #{containerSize}, #{containerType}, #{companyId}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM eir_order WHERE tractor_id = #{tractorId} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT business_type AS bizType, COUNT(1) AS count FROM eir_order GROUP BY business_type

SELECT d.date, SUM(d.gateIn) AS gateIn, SUM(d.gateOut) AS gateOut FROM ( SELECT DATE(gate_in_time) AS date, 1 AS gateIn, 0 AS gateOut FROM eir_order WHERE gate_in_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(gate_in_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} UNION ALL SELECT DATE(gate_out_time) AS date, 0 AS gateIn, 1 AS gateOut FROM eir_order WHERE gate_out_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(gate_out_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) d GROUP BY d.date ORDER BY d.date

SELECT e.id, e.eir_no AS eirNo, e.business_type AS businessType, e.container_no AS containerNo, e.status, t.plate_no AS plateNo, CASE WHEN e.audit_time IS NOT NULL THEN 'AUDIT' WHEN e.gate_out_time IS NOT NULL THEN 'GATE_OUT' ELSE 'GATE_IN' END AS opType, COALESCE(e.audit_time, e.gate_out_time, e.gate_in_time) AS opTime FROM eir_order e LEFT JOIN tractor t ON t.id = e.tractor_id WHERE e.gate_in_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY opTime DESC LIMIT #{limit}
